rows.en: (Sheryl's concert is coming up soon, huh...)

What's the matter, \p?
You've got a very slack look on your face.
Oh, it's just that Sheryl's concert is coming up soon...
Sher...yl...?
Yes. "Sheryl."
Is that some kind of singer?

Yes, that's right...
Wait, Sensei, don't tell me you don't know Sheryl...
rows.notes: Japanese trails off after 'Sheryl o...'; the implied 'don't know' is spelled out, Hilda's reply confirms it.

rows.en: That's right, I don't. Got a problem with that?

Well, the point is, you can get by in life
without knowing that sort of thing.
(Well, sure, but not even knowing Sheryl...?)
(Sheryl's concert is coming up soon, isn't it...)

What's the matter, \p?
Your face has gone all slack.
(I mean, that's true, but not even knowing Sheryl...?)

(Even if they say a new planet's been found...
I just can't picture it at all.)

What is it, \p?
Why such a serious face...?

Hilda-sensei...
About that new planet they say they've found...

Ah, yes.
Students and teachers alike can talk of nothing else.
What do you think about it, Hilda-sensei?
Well, I don't really think anything of it...

There's no point in thinking about that.
Whatever will be, will be. That's all...
That's true, but...

Never mind that. Think about the here and now.
That's what matters more.
...Yes, you're right!
(Hilda-sensei is really calm about it, huh...)

(Even if they say a new planet's been found...
I can't picture it at all.)
(Hilda-sensei is so calm about it...)

(All right, I managed to get up early, so today I'll be
the first one at school and do some self-training!)
Oh, \p. Good morning.
Huh?! Hilda-sensei?
rows.notes: x3: also nml_hld_017 male (when she turns around); fits both.

rows.en: What? What's the matter?

Oh, it's just that I was sure
I'd be the first one at school...

I see. Too bad for you. But coming in at this hour,
you won't be first, or even second.
Huh, really?

Pinon, who's both a student and a teacher, and your
classmate Shirakawa, for example, come in quite early.
...Really? I had no idea...

Well, I'm joking.
I just happened to come in early myself.
Whaaat~!!!!
(Hilda-sensei's jokes are hard to read...)

(All right, I managed to get up early, so today I'll be
the first one at school and do some self-training!)

Oh, it's just that I was sure
I'd be the first one at school...
(Hilda-sensei's jokes are so hard to read...)
(To think a single attack could do this to the city...)
Hilda-sensei.
So you made it through safe. I'm glad.
Yes. I'm glad to see you're safe too, Sensei.

The city's in ruins, and yet I, a pilot, came through
without a scratch... Strange, isn't it...
It's time we put an end to it... this fight...
...Yes, you're right...
(Hilda-sensei seemed really weighed down by it...)
Yes. It looks like you're safe too, Sensei.
(Hilda-sensei seemed really weighed down by it, huh...)

(All right, tests are finally over!
Time to have all the fun I want~!)
Huh? Hilda-sensei, what is it?

Weren't you just thinking something like,
"Tests are over, time to play~!"?
Huh?! How did you know...

I knew it...
It was written all over your face. That dopey face of yours.
Ah, sorry about that...
Well, don't overdo the unwinding. See you.
(Hilda-sensei is sharp, huh...)

(All right, tests are finally over!
I'm gonna have all the fun I want~!)
Yes? Hilda-sensei, what is it?
Ah, um, sorry...
(Hilda-sensei really is sharp...)
